title: Account security
intro: Protect sign-in with an authenticator app and one-use recovery codes.
loadError: Could not load account security. Retry or sign in again.
actionError: Could not complete this change. Check your password and use a fresh authenticator code or unused recovery code. If too many attempts were made, wait 15 minutes before trying again.
accountWide: This protects your account across all workspaces. Security changes sign out other sessions. API keys remain separate credentials.
unavailable: Authenticator setup is not available yet. Ask your administrator to finish account-security configuration.
verifyEmail: Verify your email before setting up an authenticator.
ineligible: New authenticator setup is available to verified workspace owners and admins. Existing protection remains active after a role change.
beginHelp: Enter your password to begin. Authentication is enabled only after you confirm a code from the app.
setupHelp: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually. Keep the key private.
setupExpiry: Setup expires after 10 minutes and works only in this browser session.
recoveryHelp: Each code works once in place of the authenticator. Save these codes securely now; they will not be shown again. There is no automatic reset if you lose both your authenticator and these codes.
regenerateHelp: Replace the saved recovery codes after confirming your password and a second factor.
regeneratePrompt: Generate replacement recovery codes? All previous recovery codes will stop working and other sessions will be signed out.
disableHelp: Your password will be sufficient for future sign-ins. Use this when replacing a lost authenticator, then set up a new one.
disablePrompt: Turn off two-factor authentication for your account in every workspace? Other sessions will be signed out.
verifyHelp: Finish within 5 minutes. Use a current code that has not already been used. If you just enabled protection or signed in, wait for the next authenticator code.
verifyError: The code or sign-in challenge could not be verified. Try a fresh code or restart sign-in. After too many attempts, wait 15 minutes.
